targets.beds: integrated LUFS (BS.1770) of the whole loop, linear gain only, true peak capped at -1 dBTP (peak limiter only if needed, noted per file); per-file target_lufs
targets.breaker_note: tier amplitude is baked: the engine scales by distance continuously against the tier's level (slweatheraudio.cpp kBreakTier)
targets.loop_wrap: every *_loop.ogg loops over the WHOLE file (loop_start_s=0, loop_end_s=duration); the crossfade is baked in
targets.surf_note: surf beds are decoded to mono by the engine and placed toward the nearest shore; stereo is kept in the file
targets.encode: Ogg Vorbis libvorbis -q:a 4, 48 kHz, no metadata
